name: little-alchemy-coop
description: Unofficial peer-to-peer co-op for Little Alchemy (classic) as a Chrome/Firefox extension.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && playwright test test/integration
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test test/e2e
scripts.lint:ext: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.run:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist --url https://littlealchemy.com/
